select * from d360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF ORDER BY AUM DESC

SELECT * FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H <>'D' BASE_NO = '31bdfc7a6a51f0a8f5d436be81460c4b' AND PF_NO = 'aed30618b17b2cae3332e8e9912f6f4c'


SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL'

select * from eds.EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL where file_name like '%TRU%'
-------------------------TRU_AUMNONUITF----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(28,15),AUM)),0) AUM_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(28,15),AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR)),0) AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,AUM AUM_src
,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,AUM_src
,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_src
,AUM_tgt
,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(28,15)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(28,15)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(AUM_src AS NUMERIC(28,15)) AUM_src
,CAST(AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_src AS NUMERIC(28,15)) AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_src
,CAST(AUM_tgt AS NUMERIC(28,15)) AUM_tgt
,CAST(AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_tgt AS NUMERIC(28,15)) AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,AUM_src
,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,AUM_tgt
,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
